body.x: Green Collections(www.ojocam.com) unveiled wearable dashcam "OjoCam HD" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.It is equipped with the latest Ambarella A7LA chipset with great features like 3MP Super HD resolution, smartphone connectivity via wi-fi, and super wide angle lens. With the internal battery, the multi-purpose dashboard camera can also be used to record any events by holding it by hands or placing it on a tripod via the included adapter.
